app_fee.value: International applicants pay CAD 168.25 per program (applications for September 2026 to August 2027 and for the following year); some programs charge a different fee.
app_fee.quote: September 2026 to August 2027: | International Applicants: (CDN) $168.25 | Some programs have different application fees or charge supplemental application fees

fee_waiver.value: The fee is waived only for citizens and residents of the UN's 50 least developed countries (India is not one of them) and for BC seniors.
fee_waiver.quote: The application fee for master and doctoral programs with applications submitted via the eVision application system is waived only in the following circumstances: | For international applicants whose citizenship and correspondence address is located in one of the world's 50 least developed countries, as declared by the United Nations.

gre_general.value: Set by each program; most UBC STEM PhDs do not require it (see the program records).

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 90 overall (22 reading/listening, 21 writing/speaking) on the old scale, or 4.5 on the new 1-6 scale from 21 January 2026; many programs ask for more.
toefl_min.quote: Tests taken prior to January 21, 2026 (1-120 scale): 90 overall with a minimum component score of 22 (reading, listening) and 21 (writing, speaking) | Tests taken as of January 21, 2026 (1-6 scale): 4.5 overall

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with at least 6.0 in each band; some programs ask for more.
ielts_min.quote: A minimum overall band score of 6.5 is required with a minimum score of 6.0 in each component of the academic (NOT general) IELTS test.

english_waiver.value: Graduates of an Indian university whose primary language of instruction is English may not need a test, but any program can still ask for one.
english_waiver.quote: Applicants from a university in India in which English is the primary language of instruction may not need an English language proficiency examination as part of their application. | Please note that graduate programs have the right to request a language test when deemed necessary, even if the language of instruction has been English.

also.quote: Applicants from a university outside Canada in which English is not the primary language of instruction must provide results of an English language proficiency examination as part of their application.

notes: Fee is paid by Visa or Mastercard (credit or debit). Duolingo (125 overall) and PTE Academic (65) are also accepted.
